card.statement:
We can also consider intersection cohomology with coefficients in a principal ideal domain $\mathbb{O}$ . More precisely, consider one of the following settings:

(1)

$\mathbb{O}$ is the ring of integers in a finite extension of $\mathbb{Q}_{\ell}$ , where $\ell$ is a good prime for $G$ , and we work with étale $\mathbb{O}$ -sheaves.

(2)

$\mathbb{F}=\mathbb{C}$ , $\mathbb{O}$ is an arbitrary principal ideal domain in which all bad primes for $G$ are invertible, and we work with $\mathbb{O}$ -sheaves for the analytic toplogy.

Denoting that $\mathrm{IC}_{\overline{\mathrm{Bun}}_{B}}(\mathbb{O})$ and $\mathrm{IC}_{\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}}(\mathbb{O})$ the intersection cohomology complexes with coefficients in $\mathbb{O}$ associated with the constant local system on $\mathrm{Bun}_{B}$ and ${}_{0}\underline{\mathbf{Z}}^{\mu}$ respectively,
card.label: Remark 5.12

paper.title: Modular intersection cohomology of Drinfeld's compactifications
paper.abstract: We compute the dimension of the cohomology of stalks of intersection cohomology complexes on Zastava schemes and Drinfeld compactifications associated with a connected reductive algebraic group $G$, in case the characteristic of the coefficients field $\Bbbk$ is good for $G$. In particular, we show that these dimensions do not depend on the choice of $\Bbbk$.
